headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: Management was of the view that they will continue to take price hikes to pass on costs to customers and protect their margin turf.  Distribution and International Business: The management mentioned that majority of the ground work and building blocks towards setting up business channels, distribution and service network has been done in the last 1-2 years.
KOEL is now reaping the benefits of these efforts through revenue ramp up in both these segments.

Distribution & Aftermarket Business Unit (DABU) expanded 29% YoY to Rs2.9Bn.  B2C & International: KOEL Fluid Dynamics revenue grew 28% YoY to Rs3.3Bn, achieving market leadership in engine-driven industrial pumps.
IDBI Group is a full-serviced banking, integrated investment banking, investment management, brokerage and financing group.
valuation: KOEL has undertaken targeted price hikes in suitable categories and business channels to mitigate the impact of raw material inflation.

Capex Plans  Total Investment: Committed Rs21Bn in total CapEx, with execution actively underway.  Phased Expansion: Execution of the Rs14Bn CapEx phase has commenced; the first line will be operational in the next financial year, with full production scaling by FY28–FY29.  Current Fiscal Spend: CapEx outlay for the current financial year is targeted at Rs6–Rs7Bn.
watch: Although near term macro headwinds remain, KOEL’s gradual steps towards bettering the HHP portfolio on a node by node basis is commendable.
